get.description: Get nearby available workers with infinite scroll / lazy loading (5 items per batch), category & skills filtering, top rating sort, and Indian currency minimum charge

parameters.name: skill
parameters.description: Filter by single skill (e.g. Pipe Fitting)

parameters.name: skills
parameters.description: Filter by multiple skills comma-separated (e.g. Pipe Fitting, Leak Detection)

parameters.name: sortBy
parameters.description: Sorting order: top_rated (default), nearest, jobs, price_low, price_high

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Infinite scroll offset (0 for first batch, 5 for next batch, etc.)

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Alternative page number for scroll (1 for first batch, 2 for next, etc.)
